summary: Olympic National Forest summit (also called Dusk Point) in Mason County; the registry says the lookout is now gone, and no source gives its history.

facts.status_note: Registry says the lookout is now gone; no build date or fate date is given in these sources.

access.note: Reached by Forest Service roads; storms can block the road, and no closure is mentioned in these sources.

visit.trail_note: Forest Road 23, then FR 2364, then FR 080 (under a mile, rough tread, best walked), per Willhite.

events.note: 1953 USGS map shows no roads near the summit, only trails.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The registry uses Dusk Peak. Willhite uses Dusk Point and says maps show a change in the late 1960s. The story reports both names.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build date, staffing, or fate date appears in any cached source; the story omits those topics. Willhite is the only source with detail. Brief kind unknown is not resolved. Brief elevation 987.9 m matches the registry's 988 m. Name conflict Dusk Peak vs Dusk Point is unresolved. The story is short because the evidence is short; it is above the 120-word floor only with the access and name material.
